mapper.sql: id, gmt_create, gmt_modified, app, app_type, ip, hostname, port, sentinel_version, heartbeat_version, last_heartbeat, status, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sentinel_machine_info (app, app_type, ip, hostname, port, sentinel_version, heartbeat_version, last_heartbeat, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{app}, #{appType}, #{ip}, #{hostname}, #{port}, #{sentinelVersion}, #{heartbeatVersion}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_type = #{appType}, hostname = #{hostname}, sentinel_version = #{sentinelVersion}, heartbeat_version = #{heartbeatVersion}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, status = #{status}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sentinel_machine_info WHERE app = #{app} AND ip = #{ip} AND port = #{port} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sentinel_machine_info WHERE app = #{app} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sentinel_machine_info WHERE app = #{app} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT app FROM sentinel_machine_info WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sentinel_machine_info WHERE app = #{app} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sentinel_machine_info SET status = 0 WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND last_heartbeat < #{threshold}
